$comment: Event scripts replayed by replay.mjs in the native and WebAssembly builds from the same fixed seed. Keys: literal characters, plus {CR} {ESC} {TAB} {SPACE} {BS} {UP} {DOWN} {LEFT} {RIGHT} {HOME} {PGUP} {END} {PGDOWN}, {^X} for Ctrl+X, {S+UP} for Shift with a key ({K+5}: a keypad key), and {M:x,y,button} for a mouse click on a screen cell (button 1, or 2 for the second button; +64 with Alt: Angband's modifiers << 4). Angband starts at its savefile menu (-c) after its splash screen. `graphics`: a graphics mode to switch to once the map shows, as the page's Display setting does. `continues`: keep the user directory (savefiles) of the previous scenario. `exits`: Angband quits after the last event. `expect`: text that must appear in the native output; `expectFiles`: files the game must write under the user directory.

scenarios.name: warrior-town-store
expect: You bought a Ration of Food

scenarios.name: mage-dungeon
expect: You enter a maze of down staircases

scenarios.$comment: Tiles: Adam Bolt's (graphics mode 2), switched on at the first map as the Display setting does, then a walk, the inventory and travel by mouse.
scenarios.name: tiles

scenarios.$comment: Keys and clicks as the touch controls send them: travel by click, look by Alt+click, Angband's context menu (second button), the command menu (Enter), a keypad key, a direction prompt.
scenarios.name: touch-events

scenarios.$comment: Save and quit (Ctrl+X): the savefile, then the scores; Angband quits. The next scenario continues the character.
scenarios.name: save-and-quit
